title: SEAAD: Efficient Domain Adaptation of Open Language Models for Enterprise Analytics Agents Using LoRA and QLoRA
description:
Code, dataset generators, and paper for a study of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) applied to enterprise analytics-agent components: seven-way skill routing and safe, read-only SQL generation.

The repository introduces SEAAD (Synthetic Enterprise Analytics Agent Dataset), a privacy-safe benchmark over a fictional star-schema warehouse (GlobalTrade Analytics), with 1,092 validated instruction records covering text-to-SQL, skill routing, unsafe-query refusal, clarification, and insufficient-schema tasks. All data are synthetic; no proprietary schemas or records are used.

Reported experiments: LoRA fine-tuning of a DistilBERT skill router (27.1% to 61.5% accuracy, macro-F1 0.061 to 0.537, training 1.31% of parameters), a generative LoRA pilot, and a deterministic template baseline (92.8% routing accuracy, 100% safety refusal, 23.3% SQL execution accuracy). A complete QLoRA training pipeline targeting Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct on consumer GPUs (RTX 5090 / Google Colab) is included for reproduction.
